text: Residents have contacted my office to share concerns with pedestrian safety and the need for stop contols at Sheridan Avenue and Atkins Avenue. Cars routinely speed through the intersection, resulting in a number of near misses. In a poll conducted by my office, over 80% of neighbouring residents supported the installation of an all-way stop at this intersection. I respectfully request your support on the following recommendation.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized an all-way compulsory stop control at the intersection of Sheridan Avenue and Atkins Avenue.
